faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the BITS Pilani Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) position is 21 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is M.Pharm/ M.S.Pharm with specialization in Pharmaceutics, Biotechnology, Nanomedicine or equivalent. A GPAT/GATE/NET or DST Inspire fellowship will be preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post is 35 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided and should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 56000 Per Month plus 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted online through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the BITS Pilani recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the BITS Pilani located?
faq.answer: BITS Pilani is located in Pilani, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q10. What are the desirable qualifications for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include experience in HPLC methods, formulation design, in-vitro cell line studies, and animal studies.
